commits.subject: Name Kristi-Regular as the release does
commits.body:
The release's names differ from what FontForge exported from this file;
it states them as US English names: ID 4 'Kristi Regular' (FontForge exported 'Kristi'); ID 6 'Kristi-Regular' (FontForge exported 'Kristi').

commits.subject: State OS/2 version 1, as the release has
commits.body: The release has an OS/2 version 1 table without USE_TYPO_METRICS (FontForge 2010-04-29 export); this file says OS2Version 0, which a converter reads as 'latest' and sets fsSelection bit 7.

disclose: The build is flagged italic and named so where the release is not: fontc sets the OS/2 fsSelection ITALIC bit and name ID 2 "Italic" whenever the italic angle is non-zero (the source's angle here), while FontForge took italic from macStyle, which this source leaves upright; a .glyphs source cannot state otherwise. Decided 2026-10-01: disclose.
